cohort: 327 pregnancies in 208 women with biopsy-verified IgAN (case group) and 1060 pregnancies in 622 matched women without IgAN (reference group)
finding: Women with IgAN are at higher risk of preterm birth, preeclampsia, and SGA, but most will have a favorable pregnancy outcome.
mod_finding: IgAN was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section (23.9% vs 16.2%; aOR = 1.74, 95%CI = 1.14-2.65).
